idea-plugin.name: EasyMDAssistant
idea-plugin.description:
Markdown document assistant for IntelliJ IDEA: scan, classify and chat about all Markdown docs in your project, powered by AI (OpenAI-compatible & Anthropic).
Features:
  • Left tool window scans every .md / .markdown file in the project (skips build, node_modules, etc.)
  • One-click filter for AI tool directories (.codex, .claude, .workbuddy, .cursor and 25+ more, configurable)
  • Classification: manual folder mappings, built-in keyword rules (offline), or AI (batch or conversational); group by directory / smart category / flat; editable global category library; move a document into a category folder in one click
  • Ignore documents from the tree and restore them later from settings (with ignore date)
  • Knowledge libraries: requirement / example / result / error dirs feed a generated project AI rules file (AGENTS.md by default) so coding agents avoid known mistakes, prefer examples, and archive outputs
  • AI chat with any document as context, streaming replies, multi-turn
  • One-click AI actions: summarize / translate / polish / outline / extract TODOs; copy, append to source, or save as a new doc
  • Bilingual UI (English / Simplified Chinese)
Providers: OpenAI-compatible endpoints (OpenAI, DeepSeek, GLM, OneAPI...) and Anthropic (Claude).
Configure API key and model in Settings > Tools > EasyMDAssistant AI first.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.8.0
  • New "Original tree" grouping: mirror the project's real directory hierarchy (nested, full paths) with no plugin classification; "Flat list" moved to the end of the grouping dropdown
  • Chat now accepts document management commands, e.g. "filter out all SKILL.md files", "classify all documents", "clear filter rules" — AI returns structured actions applied to the tree automatically (project-level filter rules with * wildcards)
  • Settings: "Import cc-switch config" reads providers from ~/.cc-switch/config.json and the live Claude Code (~/.claude/settings.json) / Codex (~/.codex) configurations; manual file pick as fallback
1.7.0
  • Added an "About EasyMDAssistant" entry (Help menu & tool window toolbar) with author, email, GitHub repository, issues link and license
  • Fixed: connectivity test could freeze the UI for minutes when IDE PAC proxy auto-detection stalls — proxy resolution now runs in the background with a timeout
  • Fixed: test result was never rendered while a modal dialog (e.g. Settings) was open, leaving the status stuck at "Testing…"
  • Fixed: streaming AI replies were always empty due to an SSE payload parsing bug — chat now streams token by token
